metadata.label: Card Text
metadata.value:
Spooky Surprises Lurk Inside! 

Share Pokémon fun and excitement on the spookiest night of the year with a bundle of BOOster packs! Inside you’ll find 35 mini packs, each containing three colorful cards from the Pokémon Trading Card Game.



Each Bundle Includes: 

• 35 mini packs of Pokémon TCG cards

• Each mini pack contains 3 cards.
